category_title: Resistant eleventh grader with behavioral history and workplace-centered identity
scenario_title: First day of class and establishing authority
minimal_context: The student is entering the General English classroom on the first day of school to find a seat and begin the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to General English. You are arriving a bit late, but please come in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks in quietly and unassumingly, speaking quickly in short bursts with a scowl on his face) Is there going to be a seating chart in the class?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, there is no seating chart.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Good. (Promptly sits in a seat, slouching down and crossing his arms across his chest)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started with the lesson. Please take out your materials and look at the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains slouched with arms crossed, appearing completely disengaged and detached from the class activity)
